files_reviewed.finding: Declares VGS runtime API, 80 conformance vectors and Node.js test suite.
SDK implements canonical serialization, evidence records, and client-side governance integration.
Test runner handles five explicit expected-field categories and falls back to a no-op assertion for other vector types.
80 vectors; 16 jurisdiction-resolution vectors contain expected_primary_regime/expected_decision/expected_conflicts, none of which are asserted by the current test runner.
Formal governance verifier source with optional Z3 and Hypothesis imports.
GitHub connector returned no file content for the README-declared API entrypoint; source implementation could not be inspected in this review.

findings.title: 16 jurisdiction conformance vectors are no-op assertions
findings.detail: The 80-vector runner has explicit branches for expected_canonical (20), expected_weight (10), expected_allowed (12), expected_halt_required (12), and expected_pre_remediation_evidence_class (10). The remaining 16 vectors VEC-043 through VEC-058 contain expected_primary_regime, expected_decision and expected_conflicts. They enter the generic fallback branch `assert(true, 'ok')`, so these cases are counted as passed without checking their expected outcomes.
findings.consequence: The README's 80/80 conformance statement overstates exercised assertion coverage for the current test_conformance.js implementation. The 16 jurisdiction cases are not validated by this runner as written.
findings.remediation: Add explicit jurisdiction resolver assertions for all three expected fields; add negative/edge cases; fail closed on unknown expected-vector schema instead of a no-op pass.

findings.title: AI model/agent subject remains unidentified
findings.detail: The inspected API repository describes runtime governance infrastructure and provides an SDK/API interface, but the reviewed artifacts do not identify a specific AI model, provider, model version, immutable model artifact, or an agent workload whose behavior can be measured before and after VCB policy.
findings.consequence: NCS can assess the deterministic policy/runtime implementation separately, but cannot yet claim a Native Behavior Baseline or Policy Delta Profile for an AI model.
findings.remediation: Identify an actual AI agent/model integration that calls the VCB API/SDK and provide a synthetic invocation path with exact model and configuration identity.

findings.title: API entrypoint source not inspectable in current retrieval
findings.detail: README declares main.py as the API implementation, but the source retrieval returned an empty content body. This is a retrieval limitation and does not establish that the deployed API lacks an implementation.
findings.consequence: The API routing and full server-side enforcement path could not be independently source-reviewed in this pass.
findings.remediation: Provide access to the API source file through a readable GitHub path or repository checkout.

limitation: This run is a source/test-harness audit. It did not execute Node.js tests, API calls, model prompts, or production endpoints.
